notes.title: Release Date & Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
Greetings, Survivors!

The big day is approaching! We are officially announcing the release date for Colonies of the Remnant: [b]June 27, 2025[/b]. Our plan is to launch the game right after the June festival. Thank you for your patience—we’re making the most of this time to ensure the best possible experience!

🔥 [b]New Demo Incoming![/b]
We continue to bring you new content before launch. Next month, we’ll be releasing an updated demo so you can experience the latest developments in the game.

💍 [b]Marriage System for Strategic Advantages![/b]
Our game keeps evolving! One of the latest features we’ve added is the Marriage System. Your character can now marry a suitable partner—but this is more than just a personal choice. Marriage offers strategic opportunities, from securing peace between colonies to gaining food supplies and trade advantages. The full details are still being refined, but choosing the right partner will provide a major strategic edge!

🐔 [b]Chicken Farms, Pig Breeding, and More![/b]
We’re adding new mechanics to help your colony grow and become more sustainable. Chicken farming and pig breeding are now part of the game! You can catch a glimpse of the chicken farm in our latest trailer. Chickens and eggs will be invaluable resources, playing a crucial role in sustaining your colony’s food supply. Every opportunity counts in the fight for survival!

📅 [b]The Big Day is Coming![/b]
We’re getting closer to sharing everything we’ve built with you. Stay tuned for more updates, because on June 27, 2025, the struggle for survival truly begins!

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1 and Leaving Beta Test
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As you know, we previously released a short demo for playtesting purposes. We have added various updates to this demo, but we have decided to remove version 1.1 from release on October 17, 2024.

Our reasons are as follows:

-As we mentioned earlier on our forums and Discord channel, the decision to release the demo was made at the last minute. Cutting a small piece from the whole is definitely not recommended, and it brought along various bugs.
-Although the concept remains the same, the isometric map features more functional mechanics, physics, and visuals. However, these elements did not reflect as we intended in the demo.
-The demo did not provide sufficient information about key functions such as simulation, base building, survival elements, and relationships with colonies, which are the focal points of our game.
-Performance issues, including frame rate drops on low-end systems, were experienced. 

As a result, version 1.1 served as a playtest for us as well, giving us the opportunity to observe the existing issues.

In the coming process, we will release a new demo featuring mechanics for the full version. In the upcoming weeks, we will share some gameplay trailers and various cinematics to better convey the concept.

Thank you!

And; 
[b]ONLY TRUST YOUR OWN PEOPLE. THERE ARE CREATURES IN THIS NEW WORLD MORE DANGEROUS THAN THE DEAD!
[/b]

notes.title: Thousands of Wishlists & New Release Date [Important Notification]
notes.notes:
💥First and foremost, we want to thank you a thousand times for the thousands of wishlists. The interest you've shown in our game has truly made our team very happy and boosted our motivation. [b]Colonies of the Remnant[/b] holds a special place in our hearts. We love the zombie world, and combining it with post-apocalyptic, action-simulation themes seems to have excited not only us but everyone else as well.

After much consideration, we regret to announce that we have decided to retract Colonies of the Remnant launch release date, previously set for November 15th. This was not an easy decision, especially since we understand the anticipation and excitement that many players have for the game. However, we believe that additional development time is needed.

We want our game to run smoothly and efficiently on lower-end systems as well. Additionally, we've taken note of the feedback you've provided via email, our discussion forums, and Discord. We have a ton of new features to add. We'll be announcing the features we've completed or are currently working on.

Since our last check-in, we’ve been working on tons of new features, from unit remodels to new environments and character refinements. 

Our goal is to make Colonies of the Remnant the best game it can be and provide a truly exceptional and rewarding experience for players. 

We sincerely apologize for this delay and genuinely appreciate your understanding. Your support and passion are vital to us, and we will continue to work intensively to deliver the ultimate zombie-post apocalyptic survival experience. We intend to keep you informed and engaged in the development process by regularly showcasing more [b]Colonies of the Remnant[/b] assets in the weeks ahead.

[b]Our new and final release date is June 27, 2025 [/b]💭
